observations: The historical runtime construction file exists at the pinned commit and defines run_exec as a proxy through gateway_run_exec using manager_backend or the default backend.

The same pinned file defines _distinct_backends over default, engineer, reviewer, planner, curator, and manager backends with identity de-duplication, and _set_usage_context iterates those distinct backends and invokes each backend set_usage_context when available.

Role backend construction returns the shared default backend when the requested role backend type matches and there is no role-specific runner binary, so multiple roles may intentionally reuse one backend object; _distinct_backends de-duplicates that shared object while still covering every distinct backend object.
